headline: Prabowo Subianto Holds Meeting With Gerindra Party Leaders
seoTitle: Prabowo Subianto and Gerindra Leaders Meet in Hambalang
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto gathered senior Gerindra Party figures, including Dedi Mulyadi and Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, for a meeting at his Hambalang residence.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto hosted senior Gerindra Party members at his private residence in Hambalang, Bogor.
The delegation included West Java Governor Dedi Mulyadi, Deputy Speaker of the DPR RI Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, and other party elite.
Participants departed the location following the meeting without providing statements to the press.
aiContextParagraph: On November 22, 2026, President Prabowo Subianto held a meeting with several high-ranking officials from the Gerindra Party at his home in Hambalang, Bogor, West Java. Notable attendees included West Java Governor Dedi Mulyadi, Deputy Speaker of the House of Representatives Sufmi Dasco Ahmad, and Deputy Minister of Hajj and Umrah Affairs Dahnil Anzar. While media reports noted the gathering, the specific agenda or outcomes of the discussions remain undisclosed. The meeting occurred as the political party reportedly considers upcoming strategic developments, including the potential submission of vice-presidential candidates. The officials left the premises shortly after the session concluded and did not issue official comments regarding the nature of the proceedings. This gathering brought together key figures from the president's political party for a private consultation in the capital's surrounding region.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to rapid coverage across five major Indonesian news outlets in a single day, indicating significant public and political interest.
